title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shiho's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... This is where I should be, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It was pretty surprising getting this letter in my shoe locker this morning. All it says is, “Come to the courtyard after school.”)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It has to be from Saki and Otori. They said they didn't know anything about it, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, there she is!
Shiho, come over here!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
So it was you guys all along.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe☆
Sorry for lying at lunch!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's fine...
More importantly, what did you bring me here for?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
As our way of wishing you a whimsical birthday... We're putting on a magic show for you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A magic show?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Now Emu, it's time to bedazzle our friend!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okaaay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You, the birthday girl, are cordially invited to a mysterious, mystical magic show☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, now?
Like...right here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, please clap!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Now, behold this strange hat!
Though it may appear to be mundane at first, watch as all manner of items appear from inside!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like... Like...a penguin!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, a plushie came out of the hat. That's pretty impressive...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, how did you even get such a big plushie in there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Magic!
This is the work of mystical forces, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mystical forces, sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But you don't need to think about all that...
Look, isn't this penguin so cute?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Riiight?
In fact, I just had a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's have our penguin friend help us in the show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nice idea, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She can be our assistant!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm guessing this is scripted.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ms. Penguin, take a seat here on the desk♪
Now watch as I conceal her with my cloak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Three, two...
One-derhoy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What the...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Hey presto!
Ms. Penguin turned into an assistant♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku?!
But wait, how did you swap her in?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mystical forces, Shii♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We'll now be joined by this glamorous assistant! For our next trick—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, wait a moment, you two.
The thing is, Ms. Penguin asked me to look after this for her...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? A bunny plushie this time?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh, an adorable white rabbit! We can have this little guy join the show too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When Saki claps her hands, Mr. Rabbit's gonna jump way up high♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my, she can make that happen?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Correct! I've practiced this spell many times, so leave it to me. Shaaa... Shazam!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uh... One more time!
Shazam!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat? Whyyy?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It didn't jump, but it did make a run for it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyone, follow that white rabbit!
Wait up, Mr. Rabbit!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait for me, Emuuu!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? They're gonna chase after it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Wait, why am I running too?
Some magic show this turned out to be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh! I think it just went into our classroom!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! We've got him cornered☆
He can't escape now!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh?
Wait... Everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, a successful surprise♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Surprise...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The truth is, the whole time you were watching the magic show, everyone was decorating the classroom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And the plan was to lead you here once they finished!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hang on, you guys really went all out with the decorations. Balloons... Felt rabbits...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We all pitched in in different ways!
Thank you for stalling her, Team Magic!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The four of you must be tired from all that running. We have juice and sports drinks, so get hydrated!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! You always think of stuff like that, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We also have plenty of snacks, so help yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well now, allow me to make a toast...
Here's to Shiho, the birthday girl! Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was kinda worried what this birthday would be like...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I saw magic tricks, I chased a plushie...
It was definitely full of surprises.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really need to thank Saki and Otori later...and tell them how fun this has been.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday! Even though we aren't classmates anymore, I'm really glad I got to celebrate with you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, me too! We'll always be the Class 1-A girls!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: At any rate, it was so, so much fun chatting and enjoying the snacks with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, it was. We even ended up staying at school right until they locked up for the night... Hinomori, let's hang out again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shii!
Seeing you surrounded by so many people celebrating your birthday, I was just...so happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku, why are you welling up like that...?
Well, anyway, happy birthday Shiho! It seems you enjoyed the party, so I'm glad!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shiho.
Since you're just starting out as pros, I bet this is an important time for your band. Keep up the good work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hinomori!
Your awesome bass playing has stuck with me this whole time. We gotta have another session sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shiho♪
Invite me along if you're gonna do another session with An! I really wanna hear your bass combined with her singing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shiho! The magic show was super fun☆
It's a good thing me and Saki practiced so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I heard that people turned out in force to your party and gave you a grand celebration. That goes to show how well-liked you are, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He's right. I said it already, but happy birthday, Hinomori. Emu was working really hard to make it fun for you, so... I'm glad you had a good time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
I can't wait for more fun things we can do as classmates!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shiho.
We thought you'd appreciate something you can use when we practice or perform, so we got you a guitar cloth... Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We actually asked Mr. Shindo for his recommendation. He said that cloth would have your bass looking good as new.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We thought it would be the perfect gift since you always take good care of instruments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Shiho! Keep sharing your polished sound with the world♪ And let's keep taking Leo/need further and further!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um... Thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know I'm not the best speaker, and I can come across as cold sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So I'm grateful to everyone who's my friend or looks out for me all the same.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm so lucky to have met you all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Genuinely, thank you for everything. I'm looking forward to another year with you.
